data.summary:
In [your Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase), pick an **ASTRA MILITARUM VEHICLE** model of yours up to 3" from this model. That model regains as many as D3 lost wounds, and its attacks can re-roll 1s to Hit until [your next Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase).

No **VEHICLE** model can be picked by this ability and by the Omnissiah’s Blessing ability of a Regimental Enginseer in one turn. A model can be picked by this ability at most once per Command phase.
